title: 1:1 prep - Noah
body:
Quick notes for 1:1 with manager (Sasha) - keep casual, focus on priorities and career.

Agenda:
- Quick personal check-in (how week going)
- Progress updates (short bullets) on current work: quantized kernel rollout, perf regression investigation, infra cost spike follow-up
- Blockers & help needed
- Career / growth: IC ladder talk + next steps for promotion timeline
- Feedback I want from Sasha (communication, prioritization)
- Action items & next steps

High-level updates (to say):
- Quantized kernels: landing PR merged to staging, running perf tests on p3.2xlarge. Initial numbers: ~18% p50 improvement for long-seq workloads, but +5% variance on 95th. Still investigating tail variance.
- Perf regression: Identified that batching change in autoscaler interacts badly with short-lived requests; adding guard to avoid tiny batch creation. Draft patch queued (PR 289).
- Infra cost: Feb spike traced to sudden increase in low-latency priority traffic from internal test harness. Working with SRE to add guardrails (rate limit by token).

Blockers / Ask:
- Need Sasha to help prioritize the canary rollout vs. urgent bug fixes - want guidance on stopping canary if tail latency worsens during ramp.
- Ask for 2 additional hours of infra debugging time this sprint (pair w/ SRE) to close out regression root cause.
- Need buy-in to include expanded perf tests in CI (adds ~30m to runs).

Career / growth:
- Want to discuss moving to Senior IC band late Q2. Preparing examples: led quantized-kernel effort, mentored two new hires, owned autoscaler patch. Need Sasha's input on any gaps and what specific deliverables will make the case stronger.
- Ask for recommendation to present at eng-all-hands on the quantization work (visibility).

Signals I'm watching / metrics:
- p50/p95 latency for long-seq model A (goal p95 < 380ms)
- token cost delta after kernel change (target -12% cost-per-token)
- CI perf test pass rate and time

Notes to self / things to avoid saying bluntly:
- Don't overcommit to timeline for full rollout - give conservative estimate (3 sprints) and caveat the tail-latency issue.
- Be open about tradeoffs (cost vs latency).

Possible conversation starters:
- "Quick check: are we comfortable with a gradual canary that keeps capacity headroom?"
- "If I aim for Senior IC by end of Q2, what are 2 concrete deliverables you want to see?"

Action items to propose in 1:1:
- Get Sasha to approve extra 2h/week for SRE pair debug (this sprint)
- Schedule canary rollback plan / guardrails meeting with SRE + Product (if tail latency > threshold)
- Add expanded perf tests to CI for quantized kernels (submit RFC)
- Prep short deck for eng-all-hands if Sasha approves visibility

Open questions I want answers to from Sasha:
- What is the PM tolerance for potential short-term latency variability during canary?
- Does leadership prefer faster rollout with quick rollback capability, or slower more conservative ramp?
- Are there specific cross-team stakeholders I should loop into the CI/perf testing change?

Misc TODOs after 1:1:
- Update JIRA SRV-412 with agreed rollout plan and timeline
- Merge follow-up fix for small-batch autoscaler behavior (PR 289) after peer review
- Draft promotion case doc and share with Sasha for feedback
